'''2010 US West Nationals Day 1 Mcnill LS We'll Handle This (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Mcnill]] at [[2010 US West Nationals]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|We'll Handle This (V) / Duel Of The Fates (V)|VB5-L-wellhandlethis-pre.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Michael
* '''Deck name:''' Jedi Trash
* '''Username:''' mcnill
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 6.3]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
